svg.aria-label: The six workflows of the research-master team, version 2, as numbered swimlanes: code and experiment, with the sparring gate before verification and the amber regression-guardian gate whose failures return through you to dl-engineer; the paper loop, where the blind reviewer receives only the anonymized bundle and the target venue across a context boundary; presenting, from verified numbers to a rehearsal for a defense; learning, from the Study Log back into the Study Log; the conductor's pipeline, from the tracker through a dispatched stage, its mechanical checks and a MANDATORY, FULL or SLIM checkpoint to your choice and a tracker row, forking into parallel stages under the open profile; and the stuck lane, where a stuck role changes method first, not effort, while only an unbounded-judgement step asks you to raise the session effort and lower it again.
svg.text: Same glyphs as the map. Numbered steps; every hand-off goes back through your session — the main session is the only dispatcher, agents never dispatch.
opens the mentor's answer · the audit advises; you decide
✗ FAIL — the fix goes to /dl-engineer, through you;
then /dl-engineer hands off to the gate again
sparring gate — before advice that spends more than the project's compute threshold or changes a claim or the scope, at the design
phase of a large plan, or when you and the mentor agreed a direction-level call within one exchange (pre-registrations keep their own gates)
only the anonymized bundle + the target venue cross;
anything else — memory, decision history, audit notes — is declined
MANDATORY — at the stops the overlay names; never skipped, never downgraded · FULL — after 4 consecutive SLIM continues, after any failed gate,
after any SOFT-GATE override, before any deviation from the pipeline of record · SLIM — every other stage transition (the default)
judgement turns in between are worn roles (/research-mentor, /paper-writer, …), announced
restate the claim as a checkable test
changing method first — not by raising effort
effort is chosen by task shape up front, never by "it got stuck"; no role pins max — you raise the session effort for an unbounded-judgement step and lower it again
unbounded judgement: interpreting a blind readout · resolving a record-vs-code contradiction · designing a new statistical instrument
a role asking you to move the switch
